question: Which due diligence questionnaire in the corpus asks the manager whether it requires its underlying investments to submit data to sustainability performance evaluation organisations, and which organisation does it give as an example?
expected_facts: The INREV DDQ 2022 for Funds of Funds and Multi Manager, question 3.8.1 (Supplementary Stage, section 3.8 Environmental, Social and Governance). The example given is the Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark (GRESB), and the manager is asked for its scores/results if it does require this.
acceptance: Identify 2022 FoF/MM DDQ and Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark/GRESB. Question number and scores/results follow-up are optional.
